name: Paso Desolación on Osorno volcano
region: Vicente Pérez Rosales National Park, Los Lagos
why: From the lake shore at Petrohué up the black lava sand of Osorno's flank to a lookout over Lago Todos los Santos, Puntiagudo and Tronador.
book: Free, no permit for the day walk. Register with CONAF at Petrohué. Petrohué is on the road from Puerto Varas via Ensenada.
water: None above the lake shore: carry 2 litres.
dangers: Soft volcanic sand and no shade: sun and heat on clear days.
Wind and cloud on the open slope: the path can disappear in fog.
Do not go beyond the lookout onto the volcano without registering and the right gear.
turnaround: Not at the lookout by 13:00: turn back.

points.name: Petrohué
points.note: The CONAF post and the black beach on Lago Todos los Santos. The trail starts north along Playa Larga.

points.name: Playa Larga
points.note: The north end of the long lava beach, where the trail turns inland and starts to climb.

points.name: Mirador Paso Desolación
points.note: The lookout on Osorno's eastern flank: Lago Todos los Santos, Puntiagudo and Tronador. Return the same way.
